enrollment_authentication_method.title: Enrollment Authentication Method
enrollment_authentication_method.description: The authentication method required for device enrollment into MDM, indicating whether identity verification is enforced before granting managed status.

user_identity_binding_enforced.title: User Identity Binding Enforced at Enrollment
user_identity_binding_enforced.description: Whether the MDM platform cryptographically or authoritatively binds the enrolling device to a verified user identity during the enrollment process.

open_enrollment_allowed.title: Open/Unauthenticated Enrollment Permitted
open_enrollment_allowed.description: Whether the MDM allows devices to enroll without any user authentication, leaving enrollment open to unauthorized devices.

mdm_policy_enforcement_enabled.title: MDM Policy Enforcement Enabled
mdm_policy_enforcement_enabled.description: Indicates whether the MDM solution is actively enforcing security policies on enrolled devices, including screen lock, encryption, OS version, and app restrictions.

device_compliance_rate_percent.title: Device Compliance Rate (%)
device_compliance_rate_percent.description: The percentage of enrolled devices currently reporting a compliant status against defined security policies.

non_compliant_device_action.title: Non-Compliant Device Remediation Action
non_compliant_device_action.description: The configured automated action applied to devices that fall out of compliance, indicating whether enforcement is active or passive.

policy_scope_coverage.title: Policy Scope Coverage
policy_scope_coverage.description: Indicates whether security and application control policies are applied to all enrolled devices or only a subset.

remote_wipe_enabled.title: Remote Wipe Enabled
remote_wipe_enabled.description: Indicates whether full remote wipe capability is enabled and configured in the MDM policy for managed devices.

selective_wipe_enabled.title: Selective (Corporate Data) Wipe Enabled
selective_wipe_enabled.description: Indicates whether selective wipe of corporate data only (without affecting personal data) is enabled in the MDM policy.

automated_wipe_trigger.title: Automated Wipe Trigger Configuration
automated_wipe_trigger.description: Indicates the type of automation configured to trigger remote wipe or lock actions based on compliance or loss/theft events.

remote_lock_enabled.title: Remote Device Lock Enabled
remote_lock_enabled.description: Indicates whether remote device lock capability is enabled in the MDM policy, allowing devices to be locked remotely on demand or automatically.

app_allowlist_enforcement_enabled.title: Application Allowlist Enforcement Enabled
app_allowlist_enforcement_enabled.description: Indicates whether the MDM policy enforces an approved application allowlist, preventing installation or execution of applications not on the approved list.

app_blocklist_enforcement_enabled.title: Application Blocklist Enforcement Enabled
app_blocklist_enforcement_enabled.description: Indicates whether the MDM policy enforces a blocklist of prohibited applications, actively preventing their installation or execution on managed devices.

containerization_enabled.title: Containerization Enabled
containerization_enabled.description: Indicates whether the MDM solution has activated a managed container or work profile that logically separates corporate data from personal data on the device.

cross_boundary_data_sharing_policy.title: Cross-Boundary Data Sharing Policy
cross_boundary_data_sharing_policy.description: The MDM policy setting that controls whether data can be shared between the corporate container and the personal context.

container_compliance_status.title: Container Compliance Status
container_compliance_status.description: The compliance state reported by the MDM for the device's containerization configuration, reflecting whether the device currently meets the containerization policy requirements.

jailbreak_root_detection_enabled.title: Jailbreak/Root Detection Enabled
jailbreak_root_detection_enabled.description: Indicates whether the MDM policy has jailbreak and root detection actively enabled for enrolled devices.

compromised_device_action.title: Action on Compromised Device Detection
compromised_device_action.description: Defines the automated enforcement action taken when a jailbroken or rooted device is detected.

detection_check_interval_hours.title: Detection Check Interval (Hours)
detection_check_interval_hours.description: How frequently, in hours, the MDM platform re-evaluates device jailbreak/root compliance status.

inventory_collection_enabled.title: Device Inventory Collection Enabled
inventory_collection_enabled.description: Whether the MDM platform is actively collecting and maintaining a device inventory including hardware attributes, OS versions, installed applications, and compliance state.

inventory_sync_interval_hours.title: Inventory Sync Interval (Hours)
inventory_sync_interval_hours.description: How frequently (in hours) managed devices report their inventory state back to the MDM platform. Lower values indicate more real-time visibility.

inventory_data_scope.title: Inventory Data Scope
inventory_data_scope.description: The categories of device data collected in the inventory. Expected values include hardware, os_version, installed_apps, compliance_state.

nac_integration_enabled.title: NAC Integration Enabled
nac_integration_enabled.description: Whether the MDM solution is integrated with a Network Access Control (NAC) system to enforce conditional network access based on device compliance posture.

compliance_enforcement_action.title: Compliance Enforcement Action
compliance_enforcement_action.description: The action taken against non-compliant devices attempting to access the corporate network: whether access is blocked, quarantined, or only monitored.

compliance_check_frequency_minutes.title: Compliance Check Frequency (Minutes)
compliance_check_frequency_minutes.description: How frequently (in minutes) device compliance posture is re-evaluated and synchronized with the NAC system to update network access decisions.

ota_configuration_deployment_enabled.title: OTA Configuration Deployment Enabled
ota_configuration_deployment_enabled.description: Indicates whether the MDM platform is actively pushing security configurations (certificates, VPN profiles, Wi-Fi settings) to managed devices over the air.

configuration_profile_enforcement_scope.title: Configuration Profile Enforcement Scope
configuration_profile_enforcement_scope.description: The scope of devices to which OTA configuration profiles are applied: whether all managed devices, a subset, or none.

certificate_provisioning_enabled.title: Certificate Provisioning via OTA Enabled
certificate_provisioning_enabled.description: Indicates whether device certificates (e.g., for VPN, Wi-Fi, or identity authentication) are distributed to managed devices via OTA configuration management.

configuration_compliance_check_frequency.title: Configuration Compliance Check Frequency (Hours)
configuration_compliance_check_frequency.description: How frequently (in hours) the MDM platform re-evaluates device configuration compliance and re-applies OTA profiles if drift is detected.

audit_logging_enabled.title: Audit Logging Enabled
audit_logging_enabled.description: Whether comprehensive audit logging is enabled in the MDM platform, capturing device activity, policy changes, compliance events, admin actions, and remote commands.

logged_event_categories.title: Logged Event Categories
logged_event_categories.description: List of event categories currently configured to be logged by the MDM system (e.g., device_enrollment, policy_changes, compliance_events, admin_actions, remote_commands, authentication).

log_retention_days.title: Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: Number of days that MDM audit logs are retained before deletion or archival.
